name: Achensee Strandbad
kurzbeschreibung: Lakeside lidos at Achensee in Maurach and Pertisau offer natural pebble beaches, lawns, and swimming in pristine alpine waters.
preis: Day ticket Strandbad Atoll adults approx. €7.50 to €9.00; public bathing areas partly free or small fee
oeffnungszeiten: Swimming season June to September daily 09:00 to 19:00 (weather permitting)
beschreibung:
Overview

The expansive Strandbad am Achensee at the modern Atoll leisure center in Maurach and the idyllic lakeside baths in Pertisau and Achenkirch are among the most scenic bathing facilities in the Tyrolean Alps. Situated on the sun-kissed southern shore of the lake, Strandbad Buchau and Seebad Maurach combine an exclusive bathing experience with sweeping views across shimmering turquoise waters and the rising rock peaks of Rofan. A gently shelving natural pebble beach spanning over 100 meters, manicured sunbathing lawns, mature shade trees, and floating wooden platforms create perfect conditions for a relaxing summer day. In sheltered shallow bays, the crystal-clear mountain water warms up to an invigorating 19 to 21 degrees Celsius in high summer, providing welcome refreshment before high-alpine peaks.

Route & Requirements

The well-kept beach grounds are barrier-free and easily accessible via flat, asphalted promenade paths. The shallow lakeshore with fine pebbles is especially ideal for families with young children and non-swimmers, as the water remains knee-deep for many meters, allowing safe paddling and splashing. Sports facilities include professional beach volleyball courts, rental stations for stand-up paddleboards (SUP) and pedal boats, table tennis, and adventure playgrounds with climbing structures, swings, and water play features. Clean sanitary facilities, accessible changing cabins, warm showers, and lockable lockers are readily available. Kiosks and lakeside restaurants cater to guests with regional snacks, cool drinks, and ice cream right by the water. Water shoes are recommended for walking on pebble shores. Trained water rescue lifeguards oversee the official bathing areas during operational hours for safety.

Visit & Arrival

The outdoor lidos are open during the summer season from June to September daily from 09:00 to 19:00; on sunny summer evenings after 17:00, admission is often free. A large pay parking lot is located directly at Atoll Achensee in Maurach. Motorists travel via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Wiesing) and B181. Public transit access is convenient: VVT bus route 8332 runs every half hour from Jenbach train station directly to the Maurach Atoll Achensee stop.

Tips

Combine your beach day with the modern facilities of Atoll Achensee: in unsettled weather, its panoramic indoor pool and spacious sauna world offer a first-rate alternative. Out on the water, take an early morning SUP session when the lake surface is mirror-smooth.
